characters.name: 白鷺
characters.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, one fantasy NPC portrait from our rejected first batch.
Image 2 is the existing receptionist / 櫃檯小姐. Image 3 is the existing sister / 妹妹. Images 2 and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY.
Completely redraw Image 1 so it belongs to the SAME illustration family as Images 2 and 3. Directly match their appealing Japanese anime face language, larger clear jewel-like anime eyes, rounded soft facial planes, small simple nose and mouth, tidy clean contour linework, smooth warm cel shading with gently blended highlights, simple readable cloth shapes and polished clear colors. Match the receptionist's fantasy clothing rendering and the sister's gentle expressive anime facial rendering. Keep each NPC clearly an adult and keep their own gender, profession, hairstyle, role props, recognizable costume colors and defining motif; do not turn them into clones of the receptionist or sister.
Simplify the first batch's excessive ornate gold embroidery and photoreal fabric grain. Eliminate realistic facial wrinkles, photoreal skin texture, muddy sepia/grey cast and gritty oil-painted look. Reduce long realistic face shapes and realistic narrow eyes.
Composition: exactly one individual full-body standing NPC, complete head, hands, equipment and both boots fully within portrait frame; modest soft 6-to-6.5-head anime adult proportions, with comfortable transparent margin on every side, no crop.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, absolutely no colored background, NO black/grey/brown gradient, NO vignette, NO soft opaque glow around the whole silhouette, no floor, no environment, no text or name labels. Tiny localized spell effects may have translucent alpha only. Keep the open empty region around the character completely transparent.
Character requirements: Adult female silver-haired sword mentor, ivory and dusty blue practical cloak, straight sheathed longsword. Her right hand has only THREE fingers (thumb, index, middle), fully healed missing ring and little fingers, no gore. Do not add extra fingers.
